findings.title: Deployment protection blocks automated/headless access to the approved preview
findings.impact: PHASE-10A4 executor cannot load the authenticated frontend without either a real authenticated browser session under the Vercel account or a project-owner-issued Protection Bypass for Automation secret

findings.title: No sanitized staging test account exists
findings.impact: Authenticated login cannot be exercised in the PHASE-10A4 rerun until a test account is created or provided

findings.title: Preview frontend's actual backend target (staging vs. non-staging host) not empirically confirmed
findings.impact: CSP allows both hosts; the baked-in VITE_API_BASE/VITE_API_URL value for Preview was not read. Must be confirmed via Network-tab inspection during the rerun or via an out-of-band owner confirmation

findings.title: Two parallel Vercel projects (tina-ai and tina) are both connected to the same GitHub repo
findings.impact: Ambiguous canonical project; both deploy previews for the same commits. tina-ai was treated as primary based on name match, but this duplication should be resolved as a governance cleanup item

findings.title: Vercel per-project Production Branch setting not directly readable via CLI
findings.impact: main was inferred via GitHub's default_branch and is uncontradicted, but not a first-party Vercel dashboard confirmation

remainingBlockers: Protection Bypass for Automation secret (or equivalent authenticated-browser access) must be provided/configured by the project owner
A sanitized staging test account must be created or provided
Preview build's actual backend target host must be confirmed
